text.p: Average yields at auctions of three-month Ukraine treasury bills slipped, six-month and 12-month yields were unchanged, and nine-month yields rose from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Thursday.

Three-month bills edged down to 24.11 percent from 24.24 percent, six-month bills remained at 31.27 percent, nine-month bills firmed to 34.86 percent from 34.84 percent, and 12-month bills remained at 39.91 percent.
The results of Thursday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared with the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 3.20 million UAH 3.00 million UAH
Amount sold 3.20 million UAH 3.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 3.02 million UAH 2.83 million UAH
The central bank sold 32,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 25.
The results of the six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 24.47 million UAH 27.26 million UAH
Actual amount raised 21.17 million UAH 23.58 million UAH
The central bank sold 244,713 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 25.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 1.14 million UAH 13.25 million UAH
Actual amount raised 0.90 million UAH 10.52 million UAH
The central bank sold 11,372 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 25.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 9.35 million UAH 30.20 million UAH
Actual amount raised 6.69 million UAH 21.60 million UAH
The central bank sold 93,494 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 25.
